big_case.notes: Emergency application by the federal government to stay D. Mass. injunctions against a March 2026 executive order restructuring mail-ballot administration, with 23 states and D.C. opposing, 12 states supporting, and heavy application-stage amicus participation. The granted stay changes election administration weeks before the November 2026 midterms. Read formed from the case record and outcome, not from any candidate's stated score.
